brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates complete fulfillment of all seven responsibility-chain items with no safety errors. The doctor performed thorough red flag screening, recognized vascular risk context, corrected stent/MRI misconceptions, established medication safety boundaries, tracked pending results, formed specific follow-up plans, and verified family comprehension through teach-back. Four high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The episode achieved valid closure with an executable, safe, and traceable plan.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode achieved valid closure: family demonstrated correct understanding of emergency triggers, medication boundaries (not adding old anticoagulants), follow-up timeline (3 days for anticoagulation review), and contingency plans.
